sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Safety Decals, a division of Tye's Incorporated, is a Michigan-based company that delivers high-quality custom decals, safety labels, and reflective materials to major companies.

Industry: Manufacturing · HQ: Ludington, Michigan · Size: <$50M · Products: Safety Decals, Reflective Safety Decals, Custom Safety Labels, ORALITE Conspicuity Sheeting, Yard Signs, Embroidery

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Safety Decals scores 22 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by event engagement (8/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15). Nothing was found for industry fit and application fit, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on weatherability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (10% similar on durable, printing, labels, sign); ORAFOL Europe (6% similar on printing, unit, reflective, orafol); Drytac (5% similar on durable, printing, large-format, sign). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
